node.statement: The constants supplied by the three cited externals are universal and finite, so such a positive e_diag exists (also take it below any harmless threshold needed when a listed constant is zero). Rationalizing the smaller root gives r_-=2B/(A+sqrt(A^2-4B))<=2B/A<=8B/3<=4B. Since r_-+r_+=A, it follows that r_+=A-r_->=1-(K_sq+4*C_prod)e=1-C_diag*e. The imposed inequalities also give r_-<1/8 and r_+>=1/2.
